title: Story Template (IG / WhatsApp 9:16)
prompt: A vertical 9:16 social story template for Ongea Pesa. Deep teal-black background (#0A1A1F) with a soft cyan halo glow at the top. Top center: the small Ongea Pesa emblem + 'ONGEA PESA' wordmark in white. Large open center area (kept clear for overlay text/screenshots) framed subtly by a thin green-to-cyan soundwave that runs down the left edge. Bottom: a rounded 'pill' shape suggesting a voice command bar with a small waveform inside, and beneath it small text 'Speak. Send. Done. · by NSAIT'. Minimal, premium, leaves generous empty middle space for content. Perfectly spelled.
negative_prompt: purple, microphone clipart, dollar sign, busy center, lots of text, stock people, neon, low-res, distorted text
notes: Reusable frame — team drops screenshots/quotes into the empty center.
